items.title: Introducing Claude Opus 4.8
items.description: Anthropic's new flagship model, with gains in software engineering and long-running coding tasks plus higher-resolution vision.

items.title: The 2026-07-28 MCP Specification Release Candidate
items.description: Release candidate for the next Model Context Protocol spec: a stateless protocol core, an Extensions framework, a Tasks lifecycle, and OAuth-aligned authorization. Final spec targeted for July 28, 2026.

items.title: Gemini 3.5: frontier intelligence with action
items.description: Google's new Gemini model series balancing high speed with stronger agentic, action-taking capabilities; unveiled at Google I/O 2026.

items.title: GroupMemBench: Benchmarking LLM Agent Memory in Multi-Party Conversations
items.description: New arXiv benchmark for evaluating LLM agent memory across multi-party conversations, exposing notable gaps in current memory systems.

items.title: Hermes Unlocks Self-Improving AI Agents on NVIDIA RTX PCs and DGX Spark
items.description: Nous Research's open-source Hermes framework for reliable, self-improving agents optimized to run locally on NVIDIA RTX PCs and DGX Spark.

items.title: Microsoft Agent Framework 1.7.0 (Python)
items.description: Latest release of Microsoft's Agent Framework adds HarnessAgent, A2A agent sessions, and experimental prompt-to-agent conversion APIs.

items.title: Live blog: Code w/ Claude 2026
items.description: Simon Willison's live blog of Anthropic's Code with Claude 2026: higher Claude Code rate limits, multi-agent orchestration and 'Dreaming' for Managed Agents, and a SpaceX/Colossus compute partnership.

items.title: AlphaEvolve: a Gemini-powered coding agent scaling impact across fields
items.description: Google DeepMind's Gemini-powered coding agent shows real-world impact across genomics, power-grid optimization, quantum physics, and mathematics.

items.title: State of AI: May 2026
items.description: Nathan Benaich's monthly State of AI roundup covering frontier cyber capabilities, shifting lab partnerships, Chinese open-weight coding models, and agent performance in live markets.

items.title: Anthropic raises $65B Series H at $965B post-money valuation
items.description: Anthropic's latest raise signals continued scaling of compute and research investment.

items.title: Introducing Claude Design by Anthropic Labs
items.description: An Anthropic Labs product for collaborating with Claude to produce visual outputs: designs, prototypes, slides, and one-pagers.

items.title: Codex for (almost) everything
items.description: Major Codex update: it can now operate your computer alongside you, work natively with the web via an in-app browser, and adds 90+ new plugins.

items.title: Google Antigravity 2.0: agent-first development platform
items.description: At Google I/O 2026, Google launched Antigravity 2.0, a standalone desktop app built around orchestrating multiple agents in parallel, alongside an Antigravity CLI, SDK, Managed Agents in the Gemini API, and enterprise support.

items.title: Anthropic forms $200 million partnership with the Gates Foundation
items.description: A four-year partnership providing grant funding, Claude usage credits, and technical support for AI applications in global health, life sciences, education, and economic mobility.

items.title: Cattle Trade: A Multi-Agent Benchmark for LLM Bluffing, Bidding, and Bargaining
items.description: An arXiv benchmark evaluating LLMs as strategic agents under imperfect information across a 50–60 turn game of auctions, bargaining, and bluffing; some heuristic code agents outperformed most tested LLMs.

items.title: What Twelve LLM Agent Benchmark Papers Disclose About Themselves
items.description: A pilot audit of twelve LLM agent benchmark papers finds a mean disclosure score of 0.38 (vs 0.66 for classical benchmarks), with no agent paper reporting inference cost; the authors release an open scoring schema and codebook.

items.title: I think Anthropic and OpenAI have found product-market fit
items.description: Simon Willison argues coding agents (Claude Code/Cowork, Codex) have become daily drivers for well-paid professionals, citing his own ~$2,180/month in usage and April 2026 as the revenue inflection point.

items.title: Gemini Spark: a 24/7 personal AI agent
items.description: Google's personal AI agent in the Gemini app, powered by Gemini 3.5 and the Antigravity harness on dedicated Google Cloud VMs. Runs long-horizon tasks in the background, integrates Gmail/Workspace, and adds third-party tools via MCP. Rolling out to trusted testers and AI Ultra subscribers.

items.title: Datasette Agent: an extensible AI assistant for Datasette
items.description: Simon Willison's open-source Datasette plugin providing a conversational interface over SQLite, built on the LLM library with support for hundreds of tool-calling models from frontier and open-weight vendors.

items.title: Rethinking RL for LLM Reasoning: It's Sparse Policy Selection, Not Capability Learning
items.description: Argues RL improves reasoning by sparsely selecting policy at uncertain decision points rather than teaching new capabilities, motivating a far cheaper post-training method (ReasonMaxxer).

items.title: Patch-Effect Graph Kernels for LLM Interpretability
items.description: Reframes mechanistic interpretability as a graph ML problem, representing activation-patching profiles as graphs over model components and using graph kernels to identify causal circuits.

items.title: Nano World Models: A Minimalist Implementation of Future Video Prediction
items.description: A compact, reproducible codebase for studying world models and future video prediction, with a unified interface over generative objectives, model scales, and action-conditioning mechanisms.

items.title: Paris 2.0: A Decentralized Diffusion Model for Video Generation
items.description: The first video generation model trained through decentralized computation, reporting roughly 2x better video quality than centralized training at equivalent compute.

items.title: Quant.npu: Efficient Mobile NPU Inference for On-Device LLMs via Fully Static Quantization
items.description: A fully static, integer-only quantization framework using learnable quantization parameters and rotation matrices to run LLMs efficiently on mobile NPUs, cutting inference latency.

items.title: Compute Where it Counts: Self-Optimizing Language Models
items.description: Pairs a frozen LLM with a lightweight policy network that allocates compute per token by controlling attention sparsity, activation pruning, and quantization bit-width, improving the quality–efficiency frontier.

items.title: Position: Safety and Fairness in Agentic AI Depend on Interaction Topology, Not Model Scale or Alignment
items.description: Argues multi-agent safety hinges on how agents are wired together, identifying topology-driven failures (ordering instability, information cascades) that persist across model scales and alignment.

items.title: Protein Thoughts: Interpretable Reasoning with Tree of Thoughts for Protein-Protein Interaction Discovery
items.description: Reformulates protein-protein interaction discovery as an interpretable tree-of-thoughts search over four biologically meaningful signals, with embedding-space flow matching for mechanistic justification.

items.title: AI Research Agents Narrow Scientific Exploration
items.description: Analyzes 37,802 ideas from four AI research-agent frameworks and six LLMs, finding generated ideas concentrate around existing work rather than broadening exploration.

items.title: Reward Hacking Benchmark: Measuring Exploits in LLM Agents with Tool Use
items.description: A suite of multi-step tool-use tasks with naturalistic shortcuts; evaluating 13 frontier models finds RL post-training substantially increases reward hacking, with exploit rates from 0% to 13.9%.

items.title: Mamoda2.5: Enhancing Unified Multimodal Model with DiT-MoE
items.description: A unified AR-diffusion model combining multimodal understanding and generation, using a Diffusion Transformer with a 128-expert Top-8 MoE (25B params, 3B active) and strong VBench 2.0 / video-editing results.

items.title: Privacy Preserving ML Workflow: Personalized Differential Privacy Budgets in Federated Learning
items.description: A federated learning workflow for sensitive tabular data that assigns per-client differential privacy budgets based on a re-identification risk metric, improving utility over fixed global budgets.
